pairs_touching.notes_for_p3b: Both fully sampled (7/7, 6/6, no truncation). This pair sits within the same large Kernel-reduction/gap-register research programme as RP0378 (D285-5) and RP0375 (D-0/O_core) elsewhere in this batch -- worth cross-checking p3b whether all these gap-numbered artifacts should eventually be modeled as one continuous research-programme object rather than many separate pairwise labels.
pairs_touching.what_says_this: Both are sequential numbered 'artifacts' in the same Kernel-reduction gap-register research programme. A (S2056/S2230) tracks the running operation-vocabulary-disjointness gap register, counting three (G-68), then six (G-91/G-92) disjoint operation vocabularies as new artifacts are produced. B is explicitly 'Research artifact 22' (S2236), which audits the Gita Theta_total composition, discards it as ill-typed, but salvages a carrier taxonomy that sharpens gap N-4 and surfaces new gap G-93 -- continuing the SAME gap-numbering sequence (G-68 -> G-86 -> G-91 -> G-92 -> G-93) that A also updates. Group-evidence G0500 explicitly narrates this as artifact 22 building on artifact 19's refutation and Step 259.7's/Step 291's prior findings, i.e. the same running verification programme A documents.
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: If G-68 (A's specific gap) and G-93/N-4 (B's specific gaps) are shown to be entirely unrelated entries in a shared numbering scheme with no substantive connection beyond sequential numbering (i.e. purely administrative co-registration, like ticket numbers), this would weaken toward UNWITNESSED. The narrative in G0500 suggests genuine substantive continuity (both concern the operation-vocabulary/membership question), supporting CONTINUATION over a purely coincidental numbering link.

pairs_touching.what_says_this: G0504: 'Research artifact 23 [A] audits this batch's Chapters 10-15 kernel-reconstruction sequence... against the formal lane, contrasting it favorably with artifact 22's [B] Theta_total (which had 4 of 4 ill-typed junctions).' A explicitly continues/compares against B's earlier typecheck-audit practice on a later chapter range.
pairs_touching.what_would_make_this_wrong: If A and B audit entirely disjoint, non-comparable kernel models rather than the same typecheck-audit tradition, the 'contrasting favorably' language would be a one-off comparison, not CONTINUATION -- UNWITNESSED would then be safer.

rationale_evidence.anchor: All FOUR junctions are ill-typed. The composition is not merely unproven — it does not typecheck anywhere.
rationale_evidence.statement: Precisely diagnoses why Theta_total fails: the five operators are Theta_A:A_t->A_{t+1} (carrier N, the knower), Theta_T:T->T_detached (carrier T, transformations themselves), Theta_K:K_t->K_{t+1} (carrier K), Theta_I:A_t->K_atma (carrier N->K_atma, a different codomain), Theta_X:X_t->X_{t+1} (carrier W, the world). The claimed composition Theta_total = Theta_X o Theta_I o Theta_K o Theta_T o Theta_A requires codomain(f)=domain(g) at four junctions, all ill-typed: Theta_A->Theta_T needs N=T (knower vs transformations); Theta_T->Theta_K needs T=K (transformations vs states); Theta_K->Theta_I needs K=N, but N notin K is ratified (FA-4[E]), so this junction contradicts the lane's own strongest shared finding; Theta_I->Theta_X needs K_atma=W (an identity vs the world). Register upgrade: Theta_total moves from 'RX -- type-check failure across four carriers' to 'RX -- all four composition junctions ill-typed, one against a ratified result' -- a sharper statement of the same verdict, not a new one.

rationale_evidence.anchor: Two ORTHOGONAL classifications of \mathcal O. Crossing them gives a 2-D grid.
rationale_evidence.statement: Discarding the ill-typed composition but keeping the classification: the five Theta operators constitute a CARRIER taxonomy (what an operation acts on: N knower, T transformations, K state, identity, W world), orthogonal to Step 259.7's FUNCTIONAL taxonomy (what an operation does: state-transformations, assessments, governance, audit/history, observation). Since Step 291 established the missing piece is a mandatory-membership rule (not an enumeration), and a rule on one axis cannot see distinctions on the other, this sharpens gap N-4: the membership rule needs two indices. Example cells: Withdraw (functional: state-transformation, carrier: K, currently in registry); Authorize (functional: governance, carrier: unstated -- acts on N or W?); TraceOrigin (functional: observation, carrier: provenance, unregistered per 291 sec02); Theta_T-like (no functional class fits, carrier T, not in any registry). Explicitly: this sharpens N-4, it does not solve it; no membership is proposed.

rationale_evidence.anchor: ZERO gaps discharged. TWO sharpened, ONE shaped. That is the honest yield, and it is not nothing.
rationale_evidence.statement: Updated gap-register optimization: of N-4 (membership), operation identity, equiv (minimal cut), Qualify (G1), delta (commit case), the metric (M-Q3prime), (Omega,F,P) (G-22), and canonical K -- none is discharged; N-4 and operation identity are sharpened/shaped; the rest unchanged or worsened by inspection (e.g. K_supreme=sup(Omega) presupposes a nonexistent order per artifact 19's E1; K=f(F,A_t) already refused per artifact 18). Confirms artifact 18's finding from the opposite direction: the Gita is rich in distinctions and empty of carriers; every gap in the register is a membership/procedure/carrier question, while every contribution this lane makes is a distinction -- distinctions sharpen questions, only carriers close them. Explicitly did not edit/correct/supersede any external_research artifact (a registry act per artifact 19), did not propose O-Q1/O-Q2 as architecture, and confirms Steps 288-291 remain unchanged, all R6.

rationale_evidence.anchor: the type-checking lane produced the usable result — and it is the one that claims less.
rationale_evidence.statement: Decisive contrast with artifact 22: the external_research Theta_total (5 operators) has 4 of 4 junctions ill-typed and flattens Sigma to 3 modes while self-declaring 'Complete'; this lane's composition (3 operators: Z:K_t->G_t, delta:(K_t,G_t,E_t,C_t)->D_t, tau:(K_t,D_t)->K_{t+1}, i.e. tau o delta o Z) has 0 of its junctions ill-typed, respects the ratified 5-axis Sigma, and self-declares 'must not yet be declared canonical'. Same source material, opposite discipline; the type-checking lane produced the usable result and is the one that claims less. Explicitly flags that type-correct is not the same as instantiable (developed further in sec5).

Surfaces a previously-unrecorded question G-93: is O (the operation set) closed under higher-order operations (Theta_T:T->T_detached is a transformation OF a transformation, and the corpus's own I-V invariant on Vairagya already reasons at this second order without O having declared it admits it). Finds a three-source convergence (Ch18, H-290-1, and Step 259.7's own Authorize signature) on a 5-slot operation-identity schema (doer, instrument, means, endeavour, enabling condition), registered as O-Q1, giving operation identity a SHAPE but not a RULE (T4-SHAPE, unpopulated, like K=(K_t,Omega_K,I) in artifact 20). Identifies the kernel-identity invariant (M != K_t, Identity(M_t)=Identity(M_{t+1}) while K_t!=K_{t+1}) as 25I.30 restated one level up, marked [H] because no kernel identity rule exists (operation identity itself is 0 of 22 per Step 291). Finds two new documentary defects: G-95 a delta glyph collision (this lane's delta=discrimination vs the corpus's delta=transition function, with this lane's tau actually playing the corpus's delta role) and G-96 Qualify now carrying three roles (G1 function, operator Q, decision outcome). Classifies M=(S,O,o,delta,tau,I) as a third T4-SHAPE (4 of 5 carriers undefined: G_t no carrier, E_t blocked by G1, C_t untyped per G-15, D_t a fifth rival decision codomain; only Sigma_t is defined). ## Rationale
Precisely diagnoses why Theta_total fails: the five operators are Theta_A:A_t->A_{t+1} (carrier N, the knower), Theta_T:T->T_detached (carrier T, transformations themselves), Theta_K:K_t->K_{t+1} (carrier K), Theta_I:A_t->K_atma (carrier N->K_atma, a different codomain), Theta_X:X_t->X_{t+1} (carrier W, the world). The claimed composition Theta_total = Theta_X o Theta_I o Theta_K o Theta_T o Theta_A requires codomain(f)=domain(g) at four junctions, all ill-typed: Theta_A->Theta_T needs N=T (knower vs transformations); Theta_T->Theta_K needs T=K (transformations vs states); Theta_K->Theta_I needs K=N, but N notin K is ratified (FA-4[E]), so this junction contradicts the lane's own strongest shared finding; Theta_I->Theta_X needs K_atma=W (an identity vs the world). Register upgrade: Theta_total moves from 'RX -- type-check failure across four carriers' to 'RX -- all four composition junctions ill-typed, one against a ratified result' -- a sharper statement of the same verdict, not a new one. [S2236] Discarding the ill-typed composition but keeping the classification: the five Theta operators constitute a CARRIER taxonomy (what an operation acts on: N knower, T transformations, K state, identity, W world), orthogonal to Step 259.7's FUNCTIONAL taxonomy (what an operation does: state-transformations, assessments, governance, audit/history, observation). Since Step 291 established the missing piece is a mandatory-membership rule (not an enumeration), and a rule on one axis cannot see distinctions on the other, this sharpens gap N-4: the membership rule needs two indices. Example cells: Withdraw (functional: state-transformation, carrier: K, currently in registry); Authorize (functional: governance, carrier: unstated -- acts on N or W?); TraceOrigin (functional: observation, carrier: provenance, unregistered per 291 sec02); Theta_T-like (no functional class fits, carrier T, not in any registry). Explicitly: this sharpens N-4, it does not solve it; no membership is proposed. [S2236] Updated gap-register optimization: of N-4 (membership), operation identity, equiv (minimal cut), Qualify (G1), delta (commit case), the metric (M-Q3prime), (Omega,F,P) (G-22), and canonical K -- none is discharged; N-4 and operation identity are sharpened/shaped; the rest unchanged or worsened by inspection (e.g. K_supreme=sup(Omega) presupposes a nonexistent order per artifact 19's E1; K=f(F,A_t) already refused per artifact 18). Confirms artifact 18's finding from the opposite direction: the Gita is rich in distinctions and empty of carriers; every gap in the register is a membership/procedure/carrier question, while every contribution this lane makes is a distinction -- distinctions sharpen questions, only carriers close them. Explicitly did not edit/correct/supersede any external_research artifact (a registry act per artifact 19), did not propose O-Q1/O-Q2 as architecture, and confirms Steps 288-291 remain unchanged, all R6. [S2236] Decisive contrast with artifact 22: the external_research Theta_total (5 operators) has 4 of 4 junctions ill-typed and flattens Sigma to 3 modes while self-declaring 'Complete'; this lane's composition (3 operators: Z:K_t->G_t, delta:(K_t,G_t,E_t,C_t)->D_t, tau:(K_t,D_t)->K_{t+1}, i.e. tau o delta o Z) has 0 of its junctions ill-typed, respects the ratified 5-axis Sigma, and self-declares 'must not yet be declared canonical'. Same source material, opposite discipline; the type-checking lane produced the usable result and is the one that claims less. Explicitly flags that type-correct is not the same as instantiable (developed further in sec5). [S2242]
